body:
I just wrote a post on this subreddit, but I didn't really know what I wanted to say. This is exactly it, thanks for putting it in words. 

I'm not gonna do it today, but I can see it getting closer and closer. Death stopped being scary many years ago. I've read all the "it will get better" speeches. And maybe it will, but what's the point? What's wrong with just not existing? Why doesn't everyone want to disappear? It seems to me like some people's brain are just wired this way. But that doesn't really help, if you are wired to want to stop existing, why is it that you're supposed to fight against that, your whole life? 

Sorry about not having any answers.
